platforms.name: Viki · free episodes
platforms.accessTier: Free listing; sign-in and ads may apply
platforms.evidence: Official Viki episode listing and https://api.viki.io/v4/series/41705c/episodes.json?app=100000a&per_page=50 show US geo=false, paywall=false, upcoming=false and English subtitles 100% for Episodes 1–6. This is a US listing check, not a purchase or playback guarantee.

platforms.name: Viki · Viki Pass episodes
platforms.evidence: Official Viki episode data from a US connection show geo=false, paywall=true, upcoming=false and English subtitles 100% for Episodes 7–33. The page also displays 35 episode tiles while the API lists 33 released episodes; do not count future tiles as playable.

platforms.name: WeTV · English-language listing
platforms.conflict: WeTV's 'All 47 EPs' label is catalog length, not proof that 47 subtitled episodes can be played in the US or another country. Search labels say English subtitles, but player/region access was not established.
platforms.evidence: This general listing was not player-tested by the editor. See the separately dated US Express viewer report below; that report does not establish all episodes, other tiers or other countries.

calendarNote.note: Transcribed from a Tencent Video-branded calendar supplied by a reader who obtained it from Tencent online. The original post URL, year and current validity were not independently authenticated. Date labels below are as printed in the image; they are planned releases, not observed playback. Tencent VIP/SVIP must not be treated as WeTV Express, and this is not a country-specific access, subtitle or finale claim.

history.note: A viewer directly confirmed watching WeTV Episode 39 from the USA using Express access and English subtitles. Recorded as a narrow viewer report, not an independently tested episode range or another country's access. Transcribed the supplied Tencent calendar separately without equating its VIP/SVIP rows to WeTV Express.

A user-supplied Tencent Video online calendar image (exact source URL not supplied) shows dated episode rows and VIP labels. It does not show a viewer country, a successful episode-player check, a subscription entitlement or a subtitle selector. No country-specific playback, tier, episode-range or English-subtitle claim was promoted from it.
Initial listing review: Viki showed 33 released episodes versus 35 episode tiles; WeTV said All 47 EPs. Country-specific access not checked.
